idea-plugin.name: Qoder CLI Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
Qoder CLI Launcher - launch the Qoder CLI (qodercli) inside your IDE with one click.

Qoder CLI Launcher 让你在 IDE 里一键唤起 Qoder CLI（qodercli），并把你正在看的代码、 IDE 自己发现的问题、未提交的改动直接交给它处理——不用复制粘贴，不用来回切窗口。

功能一览
  • 一键启动：工具栏按钮（或 Tools | 启动 Qoder CLI）在工程根目录打开名为 “Qoder CLI” 的终端标签页并运行 CLI；命令结束后回落到交互式 shell，标签页保留可继续使用。 支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。
  • 问 Qoder CLI：右键任意文件或选中代码挑选任务——解释、审查、写测试、重构、补文档、 优化，或“自定义…”自由提问。文件（或选区）自动作为上下文附件带入，CLI 以交互模式打开，可继续追问； 顶部的“继续当前会话”开关决定是接着已有会话问，还是每次新开。每个任务都是独立 action， 可在 Find Action 搜索、在 Keymap 绑定快捷键。
  • 修报错：当前文件（或选区）被 IDE 报出 error / warning 时自动出现在子菜单里， 把你正看着的那些波浪线整理成清单，直接交给 CLI 修复。
  • 用 Qoder CLI 解释报错：在运行 / 调试控制台里右键，把选中的输出（或末尾若干行） 交给 CLI 定位根因。
  • 让 Qoder CLI review 未提交的改动：Tools 菜单或 Local Changes 面板一键发起， 插件只点名改过的文件，具体 diff 由 CLI 自己执行 git diff 获取。
  • 终端自己选：Settings | Tools | Qoder CLI Launcher 里可指定会话开在哪里—— IDE 内置终端（默认）、iTerm2（macOS）、Ghostty（macOS / Linux）、系统默认终端 （macOS 的 Terminal.app / Windows 的 Windows Terminal / Linux 上探测到的第一个终端）， 或任意自定义命令。

各终端的追问体验不完全一致：内置终端、iTerm2、Terminal.app 能回到原标签页接着问， 其余终端新开窗口接续上下文；推荐使用 IDE 内置终端。

使用前提
  • 已安装 Qoder CLI（qodercli），且其在系统 PATH 中可直接调用 （插件只负责启动，不内置 CLI 本体）。
  • 基于 IntelliJ 的 IDE，已启用内置 Terminal 插件，版本 2024.2（build 242）及以上。
本插件是一个独立的辅助工具，只负责启动你单独安装好的 Qoder CLI。
Qoder CLI Launcher puts the Qoder CLI (qodercli) one click away inside your IDE and hands it exactly what you are looking at — the current file, the problems the IDE itself has found, your uncommitted changes — with no copy-pasting and no window switching.

What it does
  • One-click launch: a toolbar button (or Tools | 启动 Qoder CLI) opens a terminal tab named “Qoder CLI” at the project root and runs the CLI; after the command exits, the tab drops back to an interactive shell and stays usable. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows.
  • 问 Qoder CLI (Ask Qoder CLI): right-click any file or selection and pick a task — explain, review, write tests, refactor, add docs, optimize, or 自定义… (a free-form question). The file (or snippet) is attached as context and the CLI opens in interactive mode, ready for follow-up questions; the 继续当前会话 toggle decides whether tasks continue in the existing session or start a new one. Every entry is a normal action, searchable in Find Action and bindable in Keymap.
  • 修报错 (fix the problems): appears in that submenu whenever the IDE reports errors or warnings in the current file (or selection), and hands that very list — the squiggles you are looking at — to the CLI.
  • 用 Qoder CLI 解释报错 (explain errors): right-click inside a Run / Debug console to send the selected output — or its tail — to the CLI for diagnosis.
  • 让 Qoder CLI review 未提交的改动 (review uncommitted changes): from the Tools menu or the Local Changes view; the plugin names the files you touched and the CLI runs git diff itself.
  • Choose your terminal: Settings | Tools | Qoder CLI Launcher picks where sessions open — the IDE's built-in terminal (default), iTerm2 (macOS), Ghostty (macOS / Linux), the system terminal (Terminal.app on macOS, Windows Terminal on Windows, or the first emulator found on Linux), or any custom command.

Follow-up behaviour varies by terminal: the built-in terminal, iTerm2 and Terminal.app return to the original tab, while the others resume the conversation in a new window. The built-in terminal is recommended.

Prerequisites
  • The Qoder CLI (qodercli) installed and available on your PATH (the plugin only launches it, it does not bundle it).
  • An IntelliJ-based IDE with the bundled Terminal plugin enabled, version 2024.2 (build 242) or newer.
This is an independent helper that launches the separately installed Qoder CLI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0
  • Rewritten listing: the Marketplace description is now bilingual with the Chinese section first, opens with a one-line value proposition followed by a clear feature list, and finally documents what was missing before — that Settings | Tools | Qoder CLI Launcher chooses where sessions open (built-in terminal, iTerm2, Ghostty, the system terminal, or a custom command). The README is reordered the same way.
  • Wider compatibility: the compatibility floor drops from 2025.1 (build 251) to 2024.2 (build 242). The only API that needed 251 — the terminal's "is a command still running" check — is now probed at runtime; on older IDEs, where it does not exist, follow-up questions are typed into the existing session directly, which is what a still-open interactive CLI expects.
重写了插件介绍。
兼容下限从 2025.1（build 251）放宽到 2024.2（build 242）：唯一需要 251 的终端 API （“命令是否还在运行”）改为运行时探测。

1.2.0
  • External terminals: Settings | Tools | Qoder CLI Launcher can now start sessions in iTerm2 (macOS), Ghostty (macOS and Linux), the system terminal (Terminal.app, Windows Terminal, or the first emulator found on Linux), or a custom command of your own. On macOS follow-up questions go back to the very tab the plugin opened in iTerm2 or Terminal.app, just like in the embedded terminal; in Ghostty and on other platforms they open a new window and resume with --continue. The embedded terminal remains the default; if an external one cannot be started, the session falls back to it and a notification explains why.
  • Launch in the project root: the toolbar button and Tools | 启动 Qoder CLI now start the session at the project root rather than in the directory of whichever file is open, so the CLI sees the whole project and keeps one session history instead of one per subdirectory. Right-click tasks are unaffected.
新增 Settings | Tools | Qoder CLI Launcher 设置项，可选择在 iTerm2（macOS）、Ghostty（macOS / Linux）、系统默认终端（Terminal.app / Windows Terminal / Linux 上探测到的第一个终端）或自定义命令中启动会话； 在 macOS 上，iTerm2 与 Terminal.app 的追问会回到本插件开的那个标签页，与内置终端一致，Ghostty 与其他平台则新开窗口并用 --continue 接上上下文。默认仍是 IDE 内置终端，外部终端启动失败时会提示原因并自动回落到内置终端。
工具栏按钮与 Tools | 启动 Qoder CLI 改为在工程根目录启动，不再跟着当前打开的文件走到子目录， CLI 因此能看到整个工程，会话历史也不会按子目录散成多份；右键菜单里的任务不受影响。

1.1.0
  • 问 Qoder CLI context-menu submenu (editor & Project view) with preset tasks — 解释, 审查, 写测试, 重构, 补文档, 优化 — plus 自定义… for a free-form question. The file or selected snippet is attached as context and the CLI opens in interactive mode. A 继续当前会话 toggle decides whether a task continues in the running session or starts a fresh one. Every entry is a normal action, so it can be found in Find Action and bound to a shortcut.
  • 修报错: the same submenu offers a "fix the problems" entry whenever the IDE reports errors or warnings in the current file (or selection), and sends that list to the CLI. It stays hidden when the file is clean.
  • 用 Qoder CLI 解释报错: right-click inside a Run or Debug console to send the selected output — or the tail of it — to the CLI for diagnosis. The text is attached as a file and the referenced source locations are named in the prompt.
  • 让 Qoder CLI review 未提交的改动: from the Tools menu or the Local Changes view, ask the CLI to review your working copy. It runs git diff itself, so the whole diff never has to be pasted anywhere.
新增 问 Qoder CLI 右键子菜单（编辑器与项目视图），内置任务：解释、审查、写测试、重构、补文档、 优化，另有“自定义…”，以及“继续当前会话”开关；文件或选中代码会作为上下文附件带入，CLI 以交互模式打开。 每个任务都是独立 action，可在 Find Action 搜索、在 Keymap 绑定快捷键。
当 IDE 在当前文件（或选区）里报出 error / warning 时，子菜单里会多出“修报错”，把问题清单一并交给 CLI； 文件没问题时该项自动隐藏。
在运行 / 调试控制台里右键可用“用 Qoder CLI 解释报错”，把选中的输出（或末尾若干行）作为附件交给 CLI 定位根因，提示语里会点名涉及的源码位置。
在 Tools 菜单或 Local Changes 面板可以让 CLI review 未提交的改动，具体内容由它自己执行 git diff 获取，无需把 diff 粘来粘去。

1.0.0
  • Initial release: one-click launch of the Qoder CLI in the IDE's embedded terminal, cross-platform (macOS / Linux / Windows).
首个版本：一键在 IDE 内置终端启动 Qoder CLI，支持 macOS / Linux / Windows。
